name: Osanazuma ga Tsukushite Kureru no
original_name: 幼妻がつくしてくれるの
source:
One day a doll you purchased suddenly became a life-size 
autonomously moving doll. She says she will soon return to 
being a normal doll without periodic provision of your lifeforce, 
so she makes an offer to be your wife.

Considering that pushing her out of your home is
too cruel, you start living together with the doll. 

How to treat the doll girl is totally up to you.
She accepts everything you request.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE217577.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，你买来的玩偶突然变成会自主行动、与真人等大的玩偶。她说，如果不定期提供生命力，她很快就会恢复普通玩偶形态，于是提议成为你的妻子。

把她赶出家门太残酷，于是你开始和玩偶同居。

如何对待玩偶女孩完全由你决定。

无论你提出什么要求，她都会接受。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE217577.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
